evidence: Read the full diff of aeec0c0 covering cli.go, mcpserver/server.go, memory/ops.go and the added tests.
cli.go: the flags helper uses ContinueOnError with output to the error stream, so an unknown context flag returns 2 as declared; context is dispatched at line 115.

A no-argument context call still resolves the project through a.project(); the empty digest still prints 'no memories yet', now through DigestText. MCP mem_context keeps its shape without query; query is an additive optional field.

save.go splitInput/partKey against the digest's part folding: part 1 keeps the base topic key, later parts get <key>/part-i, titles are 'Title (part i/N)'; the fold key (base topic, title, N) matches. Only keyless split documents with the same title and part count could merge, not a realistic collision.
The budget loop in Context: the stale footer's bytes are added to n and its count joins Omitted when the cut lands inside the pinned or stale tiers, so no count is lost or doubled.
Other callers of memorycard context: only the mc-accept digest check, whose expectations were updated with the folding (folded into this commit).
Not a defect: flags after positional words become part of the query, as in search. The mirror heuristic collapsing architecture memories under sdd/, odd/, project/ matches S4.
